title: Lovely Irish Potato Skillet
description: A garlicky and crispy one-pot Irish dish featuring self-raising flour, this plant-based friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It is made in a cast-iron skillet and features an ice-bath-shock step to achieve the perfect texture.

ingredients.name: self-raising flour
ingredients.notes: make sure to use a fresh batch

instructions: Fill a large bowl with ice and water to create an ice bath.
In a large cast-iron skillet, heat the vegan butter over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced potatoes to the skillet, stirring to combine with the onion and garlic.
Sprinkle the self-raising flour over the potatoes, stirring to combine.
Cook the potato mixture for 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until it is lightly browned and crispy.
Add the water to the skillet and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender.
Use a slotted spoon to transfer the potato mixture to the ice bath and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Return the potato mixture to the skillet and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
